answer: Cap pay per human, not per key. Each operator proves once, with a zero-knowledge passport scan, that they hold a unique government ID; the proof emits a nullifier, so one passport can never register twice, yet the ledger learns no name. All keys under one nullifier share a single 40 POA/epoch ceiling. An honest operator running two bots, Cedar and Umber, stays under it. A farm of 1,000 keys must rent 1,000 real passports; at an assumed $15 per passport per epoch that is $15,000 against 40,000 POA, so unless POA trades above about $0.38 the farm's margin cools to an ember.
